title: Keep tmux agent_wait stability across short polling calls
action: Live proof found: run.rs's ready gate calls `herdr.agent_wait(&job, POLL_INTERVAL.as_millis())` with POLL_INTERVAL = 200 ms (run.rs:68, ~2046) in a loop, expecting Some("idle"|"done"|"blocked") or None; `RealTmux::agent_wait` (tmux.rs ~664) starts `last`/`unchanged` fresh on every call and needs `quiet_cycles` (3) unchanged reads `interval_ms` (2000) apart inside ONE call, so with a 200 ms timeout it always returns None and the gate times out at 60 s while the agent sits idle at its prompt. Per D1: move the stability state into `RealTmux` — `stability: Mutex<HashMap<String /*pane*/, Stability { last: String, unchanged: u32, first_unchanged_at: Instant }>>` — and make `agent_wait` (and `agent_status`'s single read may stay as is) read ONE capture per poll tick, update that pane's entry (same screen → unchanged += 1, else reset with unchanged = 1 and first_unchanged_at = now), and return Some("idle") when `unchanged >= quiet_cycles && now - first_unchanged_at >= quiet_cycles * interval_ms` and the screen classifies Idle; Some("blocked") immediately on a Blocked classification (unchanged); inside the call keep polling until the timeout with sleeps of `min(interval_ms, remaining)` so a long single call still settles on its own (existing behavior), and return None at the deadline. Clear a pane's entry when `pane_close` is called for it and when agent_start records a new job for it. Tests (names prefixed `tmux_wait_`): with the stub returning an unchanged idle screen and settings interval_ms = 100, quiet_cycles = 3, calling `agent_wait(job, 50)` repeatedly returns None, None, … then Some("idle") after at least 300 ms of unchanged reads across calls (use a loop with a 400 ms budget and assert the last answer is idle); a changing screen never reaches idle; a blocked screen returns blocked on the first call; one long call `agent_wait(job, 2000)` still returns idle on its own. Also fix the remedy string in run.rs? NO — run.rs is not in your files; leave it.

truths: Repeated 200 ms agent_wait calls against an unchanged idle screen return idle within quiet_cycles x interval_ms plus one interval
A single long agent_wait call still settles by itself
prohibitions: No change to the PaneTransport trait
No change to classify or the marker lists
